name: trovul-streamdeck
description: Stream Deck plugin for Trovul: scenes, direction, mute and volume dials for both PCs.

scripts.build: esbuild src/plugin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=com.trovul.streamdeck.sdPlugin/bin/plugin.js "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
